Condo buildings in Holly
A buyer searching "Holly condos" is, in practice, looking at townhouses on 60B Street or at the apartment buildings in Delta Manor, Hawthorne and the Ladner Elementary sub-area.
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Holly is east Ladner, built around Holly Elementary, 4625 62 Street, which is physically in the sub-area.

The working edges are Ladner Trunk Road (Highway 10) on the south and 64 Street on the east, with 60B Street as the street where new strata supply is actually landing. City of Delta material names townhouse development applications on 60B Street — 4726, 4740 and 4752 60B Street plus a portion of 6100 Ladner Trunk Road.

Transit: Ladner Exchange is the exchange named on TransLink's Ladner timetables; route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99, stopping at Ladner Exchange, and route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road and Arthur Drive.

Where condo stock would concentrate if it existed: it does not — the strata growth in Holly is ground-oriented townhouse product on the 60B Street edge, next to Holly Park and Holly Elementary. A listing for the new Skye townhomes describes the location as beside Holly Park and Holly Elementary, with access to Ladner Village, Hwy 17, Hwy 99, Richmond, YVR and Tsawwassen Mills.

60B Street is Holly's growth edge, and it is townhouses, not condos. City material names townhouse applications at 4726, 4740 and 4752 60B Street plus part of 6100 Ladner Trunk Road, and a Bassi Properties townhouse application at 4739 and 4749 60B Street; Skye at Holly Park is the named project selling there, with Phase 1 move-in in 2026.
SSMUH arrived in 2024. Delta's June 24, 2024 adoption (Bylaws 8394 and 8395) lets many detached Holly lots add suites, duplex units, coach houses and garden suites without a rezoning.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Holly
Skye at Holly Park (Skye Townhomes) — 4732 60B Street; developer sales address 4760 60B St. Strata

A new townhouse community by Bramor Developments — the developer describes parkside 3- and 4-bedroom townhomes in Ladner, now selling with Phase 1 move-in in 2026. Listing data records the homes as Townhouse form, freehold strata, strata plan EPP132991, 56 units in the development, wood frame, built 2026, with listing-stated restrictions of pets allowed and rentals allowed. Fresh check Nov 2, 2026: a current listing at the same address still records Building Type Townhouse, Ownership Type Freehold Strata, Year Built 2026, Units In Development 56, Strata Restrictions "Pets Allowed, Rentals Allowed" (listing data — confirm on the Form B / disclosure statement).
Hollyview Estates — 4767 64 Street. Strata (bare-land, townhouse form)

Townhouse form on a bare-land strata: listing data classifies homes here as Townhouse, freehold strata, built 1992, and the listing text states the complex has only 13 units and describes the tenure in its own words — strata fees for a "bare land strata (this means you share the common property only & take care of your own home & yard within your fence)," with a roof replaced in 2012 (listing-stated for that unit — confirm scope in the strata documents).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Holly
What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default and dominant form: A fee-simple lot carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees; diligence is title, zoning and the City's flood/drainage position for the parcel.
What is preselling on the edge is finished townhomes (Skye), not lots.
ALR vs non-ALR split: The documented position is the edge: East Delta farmland lies immediately east, and farm land in the current OCP is designated "Agriculture (A)".

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC. Nearby areas: Delta Manor and the Ladner village core to the west, Hawthorne to the northwest, East Delta farmland to the east — East Delta here is the Ladner (South Delta) farm-belt side, not North Delta.
The name on the ground: Holly Elementary, 4625 62 St, Delta, is the BC Ministry of Education school physically in the sub-area.
Schools are address-based in SD37 through the Baragar Online School Locator, and the district publishes Ladner Area catchment maps (updated October 2017).

Transit: TransLink route 601 runs between South Delta / Boundary Bay and Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), via South Delta Exchange, Highway 17, Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.

Market position stated once, here: Holly is in South Delta, and SnapStats publishes no South Delta figures — its Delta coverage is North Delta only, a different community, never used here. No Holly or Ladner inventory, sales, median or days-on-market figure can be stated.

Form B (Strata Property Act s. 59) discloses the lot's strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance and insurance summary, and must be provided within 7 days of request (max $35 plus up to 25¢/page) — in a bare-land strata it is also how a buyer learns what the strata does and does not maintain, because the house itself is the owner's responsibility. Since July 1, 2024 every strata with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years — Hollyview's 13 lots are inside this rule; since November 1, 2023 the CRF must receive at least 10% of the operating fund annually. Rental-restriction bylaws are void province-wide since November 24, 2022.
60B Street is a townhouse edge, not a lot release.

The old East Ladner Area Plan was folded into the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), and the farmland east of Holly is designated "Agriculture (A)". City documents and listings that predate July 2024 may refer to the earlier area plans; read them against the current OCP.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Holly

Position stated at the top: Holly has no known pad-rental manufactured-home park — no park where a buyer owns a home (a chattel) and rents the pad. What Holly DOES have, uniquely in Ladner, is both bare-land strata forms in one sub-area — and those two communities are this section's subject.
The parks and communities

items.t: Hollyview Estates: The homes-side point for a mobile-home buyer: this is own-land stock, the opposite of a pad — the buyer owns the strata lot and the home on it, pays strata fees instead of pad rent, and takes the full strata document set (Form B, bylaws, depreciation report).

Ashley Green: Owners hold their own house and lot; the homes are half-duplexes rather than townhouse rows, and the strata's role is far narrower than in a conventional townhouse strata. Homes-side point: like Hollyview, this is own-land strata tenure, not pad tenure, and no source describes its homes as manufactured homes. Listings market Ashley Green in family terms ("steps to Holly Elementary," homes for "the next family").

Not a park and not mobile-home stock: Named here only so the sub-area's newest "park-named" product is not mistaken for a manufactured-home park — "Holly Park" in its name is a parkside marketing line, not a tenure.

blocks.text: Mobile home parks and what to know

items.t: Holly is in east Ladner, in the City of Delta, BC — Ladner is one of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta), and Ladner and Tsawwassen together are called South Delta. Holly falls under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), which consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan.
Nearby areas: Delta Manor and the Ladner village core to the west, East Delta farmland to the east, Hawthorne to the northwest.

The growth edge is 60B Street: City material names townhouse development applications at 4726, 4740 and 4752 60B Street plus a portion of 6100 Ladner Trunk Road, and a Bassi Properties townhouse application at 4739 and 4749 60B Street. That edge is conventional strata townhouse development (Skye at Holly Park), not park development.

Flood frame: Ladner is low land protected by the City's dike and drainage system — over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure. Any home sited on its own lot here sits inside that context; confirm flood construction requirements for the specific lot with the City.

ALR block: wherever a Holly-edge parcel is in the Agricultural Land Reserve: subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified — the deposit of a strata plan is a subdivision; caps: principal residence 500 m² or less, a secondary suite only within the principal residence, and an additional residence of 90 m² or less (parcels 40 ha or less) or 186 m² or less (over 40 ha). Farm class is a three-tier test ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of the farm operation's value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31) — a flat "$2,500+" statement is an error.

Holly holds both of Ladner's bare-land strata forms in one sub-area: — townhouse-form (Hollyview) and half-duplex (Ashley Green) — which is why "strata" on a Holly listing tells a buyer nothing until the tenure is read: conventional strata at Skye, bare-land strata on 62nd and 64th, and fee-simple on the detached grid are three different purchases.

The listing sentence that settles Hollyview's tenure is the seller's own: "you share the common property only & take care of your own home & yard within your fence." That one line is the whole difference between a bare-land strata lot and both a conventional townhouse (where the strata carries the building exterior) and a park pad (where the buyer owns no land at all).

Streamside rule: all Delta properties within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, are in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area — check it before pricing an addition or a re-siting on any Holly lot near a ditch line.

faq.a: The strata choice in Holly is townhouses (Skye at Holly Park and the 60B Street applications) and a bare-land strata of half-duplexes (Ashley Green). The nearest known apartment condos are the 53 Street buildings in Hawthorne and Delta Manor.
faq.q: Are there any condos in Holly at all?

faq.a: Tenure is similar — freehold strata, monthly fees, bylaws — but the form is ground-oriented townhouse living next to Holly Park, not a shared apartment building, and a presale purchase carries REDMA disclosure and rescission rules that a resale does not.
faq.q: What is the difference between the Skye townhouses and a condo?

faq.a: Yes, inside the window: REDMA s. 21 gives seven days from the later of signing or acknowledging the disclosure statement, by written notice to the developer. After day seven the contract is binding.
faq.q: I signed a presale at Skye — can I change my mind?

faq.a: Far less than in an apartment building — the house itself is the owner's problem. One listing records a $65/month fee at Ashley Green; the Form B and budget show exactly what that buys. Never assume building insurance or exterior maintenance is included in a bare-land strata.
faq.q: What do strata fees cover in a bare-land strata like Ashley Green?

faq.a: For long-term rentals, BC law voids strata rental-restriction bylaws as of Nov 24, 2022; short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw. In a presale, also check the disclosure statement's rental disclosure.
faq.q: Can I rent out a townhouse here?

faq.a: Ashley Green is a bare-land strata of half-duplexes — a neighbouring form, not a townhouse complex.
faq.q: What townhouse choice actually exists in Holly?

faq.a: Yes, inside the window: REDMA s. 21 gives seven days from the later of signing or acknowledging the disclosure statement, by written notice to the developer. After day seven the contract is binding, including its assignment terms.

faq.a: At Hollyview the listing states it plainly: you share the common property only and take care of your own home and yard within your fence — roof, exterior and house insurance are yours. At Skye, a conventional townhouse strata, the strata carries more of the building envelope and common systems, which is what the larger fee buys. The Form B and budget for each complex state the exact split.
faq.q: What is the difference between Hollyview's bare-land strata and Skye's strata?

faq.a: Calling it a "park" describes its low-rise feel, not its tenure.
faq.q: Is Hollyview Estates a mobile home park?

faq.a: Form. Hollyview is townhouse-form bare-land strata (13 units, 1992); Ashley Green is half-duplex bare-land strata (1990). Both are bare-land strata tenure; neither is a conventional townhouse strata like Skye, neither is fee-simple, and neither is a pad-rental park.
faq.q: What is the difference between Hollyview Estates and Ashley Green?

faq.a: The registered bylaws on the Form B are the only settling document.
No. You own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad under the MHPTA. Holly's two communities are the local counterexample: own the lot (strata form), no pad at all.
faq.q: If I buy on a rented pad elsewhere, do I own land?

faq.a: No. "Holly" is an MLS/Paragon sub-area name; the City of Delta plans this part of east Ladner under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), which folded the former East Ladner Area Plan into a single Land Use Plan.
faq.q: Is Holly an official Delta neighbourhood?

faq.a: Delta's SSMUH zoning amendments allow combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies, and the RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use.
